1. **Root filesystem at 97%** (1.7T/1.8T, 51G free) — and actively filling.
2. **Postgres PANICed twice on ENOSPC within the last hour** (02:52:10 and 02:58:40, minutes before this 03:00 check). 3. **Root cause of the disk pressure:** 30 `ghcr.io/kenhia/hv-simulator` nightly images (nightly-00 … nightly-29) at 38.1GB each ≈ **1.14TB**, of which `docker system df` reports **1.15TB (96%) reclaimable** — only 3 images are in use. No cron job or retention policy on kubsdb explains the accumulation; the pulls come from elsewhere.
4. All dependent services (klams, korg, kfdc, prometheus, grafana, registry, nginx) are up and listening.

This is a resource about to exhaust with an active failure already in progress (Postgres ENOSPC PANICs), so it warrants waking Ken.
